topic: Short-chain fatty acids fuel gut lining and immunity
caption: Did you know short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) are the gut's superpower? 🌟 SCFAs fuel the gut lining, boost immunity, and even produce hormones. 💡 Butyrate, propionate, and acetate are the three main SCFAs. 📝 They're produced when gut bacteria ferment fiber. 🥗 Save this so you don't lose it.
